long_biography.plain_text:
VTB's integration of separate retail and corporate networks became a defining project under its president and management-board chairman, Andrey Kostin. The merger brought VTB24's consumer operations onto a universal platform, simplifying the organisation while expanding access to corporate, investment and retail services across Russia.

Within VTB's formal shareholder and supervisory structure, Kostin serves as an executive director and representative of the state while managing current operations. Outside the bank, he directed Saint Petersburg State University's Graduate School of Management. He also served there as a professor of finance and accounting.

uncertainties.detail: Finance is the clear sector of Kostin's professional career, but the evidence does not establish the private asset or mechanism that created his personal wealth, what currently underpins it or his relationship to such an asset. All four wealth classifications therefore remain Unknown.

Kostin has extensive executive authority over VTB's current operations. VTB annual and government materials identify him as an executive director and state representative within a predominantly state-controlled shareholder structure; these positions are management and governance mandates, not personal title to the bank's balance sheet or assets.

VTB's archived 2017 biography reported that Kostin held 0.00183% of ordinary shares and 0.00036% of charter capital. The holding was negligible, is historical and has not been verified as current, so it does not support a shareholder-based wealth relationship.

VTB disclosures aggregate remuneration for management bodies and do not establish Kostin's current individual compensation or show that compensation created his principal personal wealth. Historical press rankings and unsourced net-worth estimates are excluded.

Andrey and Andrei are transliteration variants for Андрей. The patronymic Leonidovich, Moscow birth, exact date and VTB role distinguish this subject from more than 50 LinkedIn namesakes and from Ukrainian former prosecutor general Andriy Kostin.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website met the official cross-link or two-source identity threshold. A LinkedIn result sharing the name and VTB employer is based in Rostov and lacks the target's title or patronymic, so it is not proposed.

Politics, sanctions, allegations, legal matters, controversy, private-family trivia, unverified personal-asset claims, current net-worth estimates and vessel-specific research are excluded from the biographies and evidence ledger.

No reliable evidence supports a secondary nationality or secondary residence. The name suffix is optional, while calculated ages, death, internal-note and unknown-name fields remain system-managed or inapplicable.
